title: Query-backed model links must show loading, error and missing-data states separately
answers: model version page shows raw model id before the name loads
deleted source model shows an id with no error
source model link flashes the m- hash then changes
logged model fetch failure not visible on model version page
body:
Symptom: On the model version page the raw `m-…` model ID flashes before the model name appears. A deleted or unreachable source model silently shows the ID, so it looks like a slow load.
Root cause: mlflow/server/js/src/model-registry/components/ModelVersionSourceModelLink.tsx:ModelVersionSourceModelLink read only `data` from useGetLoggedModelQuery. Loading, fetch error and a missing `info.experiment_id` all rendered the same bare-ID span.
Fix pattern: branch on `isLoading` first and render a labelled ParagraphSkeleton. Then fall back to the plain ID only for `error` or a missing `experiment_id`. Render the Link only when the experiment ID is known. Use the model ID as link text when `name` is empty.
Constraints: the plain-ID fallback is for error or missing experiment only, not for loading. Do not discard `isLoading`/`error` from a query hook when rendering its data.
applies: Any component that renders data from a react-query hook in the model registry UI where a fallback is shown.
says: The source model link flashes an ugly ID code before loading the real name.
Show a placeholder skeleton while fetching the source model on the model version page.
Deleted source models silently show raw identifiers instead of reporting an error.
Display an explicit fetch failure when the source model cannot be loaded.
Only render a clickable source link when its experiment details are known.
search: In model registry UI components using react-query hooks like useGetLoggedModelQuery in ModelVersionSourceModelLink.tsx, query-backed source model links must explicitly branch on isLoading to render a ParagraphSkeleton instead of showing raw IDs while loading. Fall back to rendering a plain model ID only when error occurs or info.experiment_id is missing, using the model ID as link text if name is empty, and only render the Link when the experiment ID is known. Applies when rendering react-query hook data with fallbacks; do not discard isLoading or error, and never use the plain-ID fallback during loading.
